# ScamLens

ScamLens is a parent-focused AI safety check for suspicious messages, screenshots, links, and descriptions of calls or conversations.

## Purpose
Help people understand common scam warning signs and decide on safer next steps before clicking, paying, replying, or sharing information.

## Supported inputs
- Pasted messages
- Screenshots (foundation only in Phase 1)
- HTTP/HTTPS URLs (shape validation only in Phase 1)
- Descriptions of suspicious calls or conversations

## Limitations
ScamLens is a second opinion, not a guarantee. AI analysis can be wrong and should not replace independent verification through trusted official channels.

## Privacy principles
Phase 1 keeps full result data in session memory and stores only lightweight metadata when a user explicitly saves a result to local history. ScamLens should never request passwords, PINs, OTPs, or recovery codes.

## Product roadmap boundary
Real AI provider integration, OCR, authentication, billing, family invitations, notifications, and organizational/API features are planned for later phases and are not represented as active Phase 1 capabilities.
